newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli allied soldier wounded in Lebanon fighting.
newsitem.headline: Israeli allied soldier wounded in Lebanon fighting.

text.p: A member of Israel's Lebanese militia ally was seriously wounded in clashes with Hizbollah guerrillas in south Lebanon, Israeli security sources said on Wednesday.
"A South Lebanon Army soldier sustained serious wounds in an attack in the central sector of the security zone," the sources told Reuters.
Pro-Iranian Hizbollah guerrillas are fighting to oust Israeli and allied militia forces from Israel's 15-km (nine-mile) deep south Lebanon occupation zone.
Some 1,000 Israeli troops and the pro-Israeli 3,000-strong South Lebanon Army militia patrol the zone set up in 1985 to deter cross-border guerrilla raids on northern Israel.
